reader.requirement: At --std 85 a file created with ORGANIZATION [IS] RELATIVE keeps relative organization for its whole existence: an OPEN (other than OUTPUT, which creates a new file) through a description of another organization or other fixed file attributes must not reinterpret it (the implementor-defined validation of VIII.4.4.4 GR8 answers I-O status 39), and OPEN OUTPUT establishes the organization anew.

edition-consulted.switches: refuses the 2023 LINE SEQUENTIAL and RECORD SEQUENTIAL phrases below 2023; the RELATIVE arm passes untouched
DialectBehavior.RelativeWriteKeyOutOfRangeIsPermanentError: a key of 0 is '24' at 85 vs '34' from 2014 (adjacent rule, not the permanence)

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|CobolVersion|Dialect|IsActive over FileControlBinder, FileConnector, KeyedConnector, RelativeConnector, SequentialConnector, FixedFileAttributes, Store/MetaPage: the GR10 '39' comparison (FileConnector.Open -> FixedAttributeConflict overrides -> Conflicts) consults no edition.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the organization's permanence and the '39' refusal are the same code at 85 and 2023; only the 2023 LINE/RECORD SEQUENTIAL phrases are refused at 85
reader.witnesses-cover: part: witnesses cover organization change (relative<->indexed<->sequential I-O/EXTEND); not exercised: a relative description with a different record size, an empty relative store reopened as indexed, a sequential OPEN OUTPUT re-creating the file, the bare RELATIVE form without ORGANIZATION IS

reader.notes: The organization is recorded in the relative/indexed store header and compared at every non-OUTPUT OPEN of an existing file; a conflicting description gets 39 and the store is left intact. The path is edition-agnostic; the only edition gate near the clause is the 2023 LINE/RECORD SEQUENTIAL phrase refusal.

refuter.evidence: Probe refute-1985-04/c1/r1.cob at --std 85 (creation paths the reader did not try: OPTIONAL relative file created by OPEN I-O and by OPEN EXTEND, §1985:VIII.4.4.4 GR15, then reopened under other organizations): IO-CREATE=05 IOCREATED-AS-IX=39 IOCREATED-AS-SQIO=39 EXT-CREATE=05 EXT-WRITE=00 EXTCREATED-AS-IX=39 EXTCREATED-AS-SQEXT=39 EXTCREATED-AS-SQIN=00 RE-READ=00 EXT1AAAA. The organization is established by every creating OPEN (OUTPUT, I-O, EXTEND) and an organization-changing OPEN that would write is refused with 39; the store stays readable through its relative description. The one soft spot: OPEN INPUT through a SEQUENTIAL description of the relative store answers 00 and READ returns the store's header bytes as a record (SE-READ=00 [M   X..]); this reinterprets the bytes but does not change the file's organization, and §1985:VIII.4.4.4 GR8 leaves which fixed attributes OPEN validates to the implementor, so it does not refute GR1. cite.py: OK §1985:VIII.2.5.3 GR1 ('established at the time a file is created and cannot subsequently be changed'); OK §1985:VIII.4.4.4 GR15 ('EXTEND or I-O phrase creates the file'); OK §1985:VIII.4.4.4 GR8 ('The implementor defines which of the fixed file attributes are validated').
